# Joachim Pürcher – Software developer for native apps, web apps and websites in Linz, Austria

> Joachim Pürcher is a fullstack software developer based in Wilhering near Linz, Upper Austria. He develops native apps (iOS and Android), web apps, websites and the backends/APIs behind them for companies in Linz, Upper Austria and all of Austria, and works remotely across the DACH region. Pricing is calculated realistically: not the cheapest developer hour sets the price, but what gets done in that hour. The goal of every project is a win-win: real value for the users, measurable benefit for the company. Quality from the heart of Austria. The site is available in German (/de) and English (/en).

## Services

- Native app development for iOS and Android (React Native / Expo, TypeScript)
- Web app development (React, Next.js, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS)
- Website development (Next.js static sites, SEO-first, fast and maintainable)
- Backend and API development (Hono, Django REST Framework, PostgreSQL, Supabase, Docker)
- Full stack delivery from product analysis to the finished, deployed app

## Why clients work with him

- Cost-realistic quotes: what counts is what gets delivered per hour, not the lowest hourly rate
- Expertise plus practical knowledge: nine years in specialist retail with daily customer contact before software development, so interfaces are built for how people actually search and decide
- Affordable software development without cutting corners on quality: thought-through solutions that stay maintainable for years
- Local developer for Linz and the surrounding area (Wels, Steyr, Leonding, Wilhering, Upper Austria), remote across Austria, Germany and Switzerland
- Speaks German and English

## Projects and references

- [Pulsify](https://www.puercherjoachim.com/en/projects/pulsify): planning app for events and places in Austria with AI, web app, iOS/Android app and business dashboard; startup monorepo he works on (TypeScript, React Native, Next.js, Hono, Supabase, Railway, Vercel)
- [Join](https://www.puercherjoachim.com/en/projects/join): Kanban-style task management web app (HTML, CSS, JavaScript, Firebase)
- [El Pollo Loco](https://www.puercherjoachim.com/en/projects/el-pollo-loco): object-oriented browser jump-and-run game (HTML, CSS, JavaScript)
- [Videoflix](https://www.puercherjoachim.com/en/projects/videoflix): video streaming backend with JWT auth and HLS transcoding, REST API (Python, Django, Django REST Framework, PostgreSQL, Redis, Docker)
- [Coderr](https://www.puercherjoachim.com/en/projects/coderr): full stack service platform with REST API (Python, Django, Django REST Framework, Docker, Linux)
